g.text: Holding minus equal-duration straight flight | matched order and aircraft dose
Positive values mean higher D for Holding; all 12 scenes retained
Both arms must pass at the same dose and order; missing pairs are NA (bottom crosses), never zero. No valid baseline is required for this difference.
The title statistic uses the saved median-of-order-medians within the common cutoff; it is not the median of the plotted curve. No confidence band or causal attribution.
